content.comment_body: Hello, Is diagnostic communication possible between [product_name] and [product_name]? When I disconnect the UTP cable, [product_name] does not register an error in the GET or PUT block. The memory does not reset to zero but retains the last value read from [product_name]. [product_name] only detects UTP cable disconnection when it is connected to a switch; otherwise, connection errors are not detected. [user_name]

There are many factors to consider, including whether the devices are connected directly or through a switch or router. Based on the setup, an error may or may not be detected. For added safety, I use a lifetime bit exchanged between the devices.
Hello, That is one approach, but what happens to the PUT and GET block error outputs? According to the documentation, they should indicate a connection error.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering issues with unreliable diagnostics when communication between [product_name] and [product_name] fails, especially when the physical network connection is disrupted. The system does not always update memory status or signal errors in communication blocks, which leads to uncertainty about system status and error handling. There is a need for more reliable and visible detection of connectivity and communication faults.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the system to reliably detect communication problems and automatically update memory status or trigger error outputs in communication blocks when the network connection is interrupted.
